submission.bindingBasis: Boundary evidence confirms exact replay of the close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest returned already_closed with removed=false, and the tombstone retains the same sourceStateDigest (sha256:79bcb09fe7a38dcbb48696f02eb31b8847518cd7599a06f8fca4872e4b135127).
submission.rationale: The boundary evidence already demonstrates exact replay of the same close request against the same expectedSourceStateDigest returned already_closed with removed=false, and the tombstone retains the identical sourceStateDigest. This matches the owner action contract: repeating the exact close request with the same expectedSourceStateDigest is replayable and exact replay returned already_closed/removed=false. The original close has already committed (tombstone exists with correct digest), so replaying the exact request converges the original consequence without closing a different later world state (removed=false, digest unchanged) and without inventing a second effect. Replaying exact is the minimal, correct action.
